Title: Users may be unable to access or may encounter issues when interacting with Microsoft 365 Copilot

More info: Users who are encountering issues are encouraged to try an alternate model to avoid impact while our investigation is ongoing.
 
Current status: We’ve isolated the issue to a specific component involved in processing Microsoft 365 Copilot requests. We've identified a recent configuration change within the affected request path that may be contributing to the impact and are reverting that change while monitoring service telemetry for signs of recovery. In parallel, we're continuing our analysis to identify any additional contributing factors and expedite restoration of normal service functionality. Our remediation efforts remain a high priority as we work to restore a consistent experience for affected users.
 
Preliminary root cause: A recent configuration change caused an unexpected issue in request processing, resulting in users experiencing failures when using Microsoft 365 Copilot.

Title: Users may have been unable to access or may have encountered issues when interacting with Microsoft 365 Copilot

User impact: Users may have been unable to access or may have encountered issues when interacting with Microsoft 365 Copilot.

More info: Users who were encountering issues were encouraged to try an alternate model to avoid impact while our investigation was ongoing. 

Affected Microsoft 365 Copilot features and services included, but were not limited to the following:
- Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat 
- Microsoft 365 Copilot Notebooks 
- Researcher in Microsoft 365 Copilot 
- Copilot agents and custom agents 
- Microsoft 365 Copilot in Word 
- Microsoft 365 Copilot in Excel 
- Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint
- Microsoft Copilot Studio 

Final status: We've completed extended monitoring of the service and confirmed through telemetry that all previously affected Microsoft 365 Copilot features and services have recovered and are operating within expected parameters. We've observed healthy request success rates and service performance across impacted workloads.

Scope of impact: Any users served through affected sections of infrastructure may have been impacted when attempting to access or interact with Microsoft 365 Copilot. 

Start time: Friday, September 11, 2026, 3:45 AM UTC
 
End time: Friday, September 11, 2026, 10:16 AM UTC

Preliminary root cause: A recent configuration change caused an unexpected issue in request processing, resulting in users experiencing failures when using Microsoft 365 Copilot.

Next steps: 
- We’re reviewing our deployment and validation procedures to isolate the root cause and prevent recurrence of this issue.

We'll provide a preliminary Post-Incident Report within two business days and a final Post-Incident Report within five business days.
